Persisted data is rewritten by an explicit maintenance command --workspace-path-rekey (decision D5, 2026-10-07) modelled on McpDatabaseEncryptionTransitionCommand: required backup unless --dry-run, report with old->new mapping and before/after counts; one transaction per database with foreign keys deferred or suspended and fully re-validated (decision D6: SQLite defer_foreign_keys, SQL Server NOCHECK then WITH CHECK CHECK, PostgreSQL DEFERRABLE + SET CONSTRAINTS ALL DEFERRED); set-based UPDATE per workspace column from a mapping table limited to Windows-shaped values; C# recomputation of hashed values (federation GlobalWorkspaceId/CanonicalWorkspaceId and hub hash-keyed Workspaces rows, TriageGroups GroupKey/GroupId with repointed children, HandoffIngestionRuns ReplayIdentity); FileGitHubWorkspaceTokenStore keys rewritten. No legacy dual-key lookup (decision D7): a startup guard refuses to start while any Windows-shaped workspace id still contains a backslash. Enrolled proxies are re-enrolled once after deploy (only PAYTON-LEGION2 today). Plan: docs/plans/2026-10-07-federation-fixes.md section 4c."
